o.norm: illegal index: 127 into array of length 17

i.norm: When the start index passed to {@link HexDump#dump(byte[], long, Appendable, int, int)} is greater than or equal to the data array's length, the method must reject it with an {@link ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException} before writing anything. Here the array holds 17 bytes but the index is 127, so the call is expected to fail.
